checker: fact-checker CS-battery (independent random sample of battery base and excluded records)
sample_method: Drawn by the coordinator with random.Random(20261117): 16 base records (excluding six already checked in R1) and 6 excluded records. Scope by script from ledger/evidence.csv: every stated row of the 22 records plus every inferred row of relationship, lookalike_of, tier, tier_secondary, welder_postings, parent_company and exclusion_reason (213 rows: 134 stated, 79 inferred). Extended (in_scope false): the six unknown-tagged welder_postings rows of these records, checked because their plants.csv field asserts 'none found' or 'unknown'.
decision_rule: Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting through a city shared by several sites (campus rule), misdates a posting, the quote is not on the page (raw source incl. JSON-LD checked first), or an inferred relationship breaks the written battery rule (lookalike of EK Machine when a stated product, company-level enough, is generator enclosures, sub-base or day tanks, or BESS enclosures or skids). A 'none found'/'unknown' posting value is corrected when the employer's own board, linked from its site, shows a site-named welder posting that was open on the finder's read date. Confirmed otherwise. Unreachable only when the source cannot be reached at all (not confirmed, not in the rate).
error_rate_note: 7/212 = 3.3% over the delegated scope (213 rows less 1 unreachable). Including the 6 extended unknown-tagged welder_postings rows: 9/218 = 4.1%. On stated rows only (in scope): 4/133 = 3.0% (nVent name, nVent parent, nVent exclusion_reason, Winco tier_secondary). By plant: 5 of 22 records carry a correction (GPC, Simplex, Winco, nVent Chattanooga; plus Maysteel Garland and Lynchburg in the extended set). Score-moving: GPC, Garland, Lynchburg labor 0 -> 12 (open welder posting under 60 days); Simplex relationship new -> lookalike (first ranking key). No closed business, wrong plant, wrong process, wrong tier or invented fact.
repeated_kinds: other: 3 in scope, 5 with the extended rows - two roots. (a) MISSED OR PART-READ OWN JOB BOARD (3: GPC Milwaukee, Maysteel Garland, Maysteel Lynchburg). GPC's company page links an own Workday board ('Careers' -> globalpowercomponents.wd115.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/GPC) that the finder called 'no job board found'; it has a MIG Welder at '51st Street' posted 2026-11-10. Maysteel's Dayforce board was read as 11 openings when it holds 18 (lazy-loaded list); Welder II Garland (posted 2026-11-01) and Welder I Lynchburg (posted 2026-10-21) were missed though both predate the read. SWEEP: every battery base/profiled record whose welder_postings is 'none found' or 'unknown' - open the company site's careers href in raw source (Workday/UKG/Dayforce/ADP/Paylocity/Lever/SmartRecruiters links) and read the full list through its JSON API or a scrolled browser render (Workday CXS jobs POST, Dayforce full render, UKG LoadSearchResults, ADP job-requisitions, Lever/SmartRecruiters postings APIs). Named first: the other Maysteel records if any, GPC's other EPA sites (4101 W Burnham St has its own board location 'Burnham'), and every finder row that says 'no job board found'. (b) RELATIONSHIP RULE MISREAD (2: Simplex, nVent): Simplex's reasoning lists the rule without 'day tanks'; nVent's says no BESS line though nVent's own BESS page states one. SWEEP (cheap): every battery record with relationship 'new' whose products row names day tanks, sub-base tanks, generator enclosures or BESS enclosures/skids at company level.

method: Scope by script from evidence.csv (213 rows, 63 distinct URLs). Every URL fetched fresh on 2026-11-17 with tools/fetch_page.fetch(with_raw=True) into a private scratchpad cache; 62 returned 200 (browser for Workday, Dayforce, ITN Hire, UKG, ADP, city news, Barchart 202 challenge resolved); the Wayback snapshot for Generac's 2022 facility page returned 502/connection reset on three tries (unreachable). Every '...'-joined quote fragment was matched against normalised visible text plus raw source: 206 of 206 quoted rows found; 7 rows have no URL (inferred posting rows), checked against the boards directly. Boards read today through their APIs or full browser renders: GTI Lever postings API (70 openings), GPC Workday CXS (93, all pages, posting detail incl. JSON-LD datePosted), Maysteel Dayforce (18), MCG SmartRecruiters API (82), Robinson UKG LoadSearchResults (73), AVL ADP job-requisitions (13), Simplex Paylocity page JSON (10), Generac Workday CXS ('welder', 'weld', 'Whitewater', 'Sussex'), Caterpillar careers search (browser), Newberry ITN Hire (7), Tramont/Winco/Gillette careers pages. Corrected quotes re-checked with tools/fetch_page.py --check at the corrected URL (all FOUND). EPA DFR coordinates compared numerically with plants.csv. Open/closed: one WebSearch (Chillicothe) and one for Girtz postings, discovery only; ECHO facility search used for Chillicothe. No ledger file was edited. Wayback retried a fourth time before writing: still no response.
apply_note: apply_factcheck.py --apply run on a scratch copy of ledger/ and tools/: 209 confirmed, 9 corrected, 1 unreachable, 0 unmatched; no score component cites a corrected claim. plants.csv diff shows exactly seven changed fields: GPC, Maysteel Garland and Maysteel Lynchburg welder_postings; Simplex relationship new -> lookalike; nVent Chattanooga name (drops '(former Lectrus site)'), relationship new -> lookalike and exclusion_reason ('Under review ...'). Winco tier_secondary and nVent parent_company are tag/source-only fixes (plants_csv_value equals the current field). Not set by the script: lookalike_of for Simplex and nVent (no rows exist; coordinator adds 'EK Machine', inferred); nVent status (coordinator's call - the record stays 'excluded' with an 'Under review' reason until decided); GPC website change; field drift, leads and status problems. evidence_row = csv record index + 2 (records with embedded newlines make it differ from the physical file line). The real ledger was not edited.
